confirmed: XRP is about $1.31 Monday evening, up about 0.5% over 24 hours and about 0.4% over 7 days, and about 14.3% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 5:57 PM MDT; Kraken last trade $1.3073, 24h range $1.2711 to $1.3100).

Ripple's planned national trust bank got final approval: the OCC (the federal bank regulator) granted final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank, completing the conditional approval from December 2025. It will manage the reserves backing Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and offer custody of digital assets for businesses; it cannot take deposits or make loans, and RLUSD stays issued by Ripple's New York-regulated trust company (Ripple press release via Business Wire, Oct 26, 7:13 PM EDT; announced by CEO Brad Garlinghouse on X). This is about Ripple's stablecoin and custody business, not a change to XRP itself.

At Swell, Ripple announced new Ripple Treasury features, including AI workflow tools and '24/7 Returns' that let eligible corporate customers earn returns on qualifying digital assets such as RLUSD outside banking hours (Ripple, Oct 26).

Crypto slipped again overnight as traders cut risk before the Fed's Oct 28 decision: bitcoin briefly fell below $80,000 and XRP was down about 3% at one point in Asian hours before steadying near $1.28 to $1.29. A rate hold is widely expected; markets are watching for hints of a December hike, with oil still near yearly highs on US–Iran tensions (CoinDesk and Investing.com, Oct 26).

Aviva Investors added a tokenized share class of its £22 billion Sterling Liquidity Fund on the XRP Ledger, following its dollar-fund share class in July. The £22B is the whole fund's size; the two tokenized classes together hold a little over £86 million. These are fund shares, not XRP purchases (Financial News, Oct 26; on-ledger issuance visible on XRPL explorers).

XRP-branded ads with the slogan 'Crypto Responsibly' appeared in and on New York subway trains around 42nd Street ahead of Ripple's Swell conference (Oct 27–29); the cost, length and sponsor details have not been officially confirmed (U.Today, Oct 26).

US spot XRP ETFs took in about $4.25M net in the week through Oct 23, after a $1.84M outflow the week before ended a 13-week inflow streak; Franklin Templeton's XRPZ led. Cumulative net inflows are about $1.8B and net assets about $1.48B to $1.57B, below inflows because XRP's price has fallen (SoSoValue data via Crypto Briefing and TokenPost). Monday's flow data is not out yet.

Franklin Templeton added about $150M of its tokenized money-market fund shares to the XRP Ledger, bringing its XRPL total to about $200M in a single wallet; these are fund shares, not XRP buys (CoinDesk, Oct 24).

Ripple's regular monthly escrow release of up to 1 billion XRP is scheduled for Nov 1 (00:00 UTC, which is 6 PM MDT Oct 31); in October 700M was re-locked and 300M stayed out (ledger data via TokenPost). This is routine, not new.

Arf, a Swiss-regulated payment-finance firm, partnered with Ripple to provide short-term RLUSD settlement loans on the XRP Ledger; a second phase depends on validator approval of the XLS-65/66 lending amendments (Arf, Ripple, Oct 22).
An XRP Ledger bug fix (fixCleanup3_4_0) was pushed from Oct 23 to about Nov 4 after validator support briefly dipped; support is now 31 of 35 (CoinDesk, Oct 22).
Evernorth (XRPN) filed a preliminary, not-yet-effective S-1 on Oct 23 for up to 5.2M shares it may sell to Cantor (about $80.7M); the filing does not by itself confirm new XRP purchases (SEC filing).
not_confirmed: Ripple is not releasing 1.3 billion XRP on Nov 1: the scheduled escrow release is up to 1 billion XRP. No BlackRock XRP ETF filing or BlackRock–Ripple deal exists; BlackRock's Max Stein speaking on a Swell panel is not an announcement, and overnight 'BlackRock to sell $27 trillion of XRP' posts have no source. Aviva did not tokenize £22 billion or buy XRP: the £22B is the fund's total size and about £86M sits in the tokenized classes. The New York subway ads are marketing, not a partnership or adoption news. Ripple's CEO did not say XRP's market cap will hit '$196 trillion' or price it at $118,920, and there is no confirmed '$327,000 XRP on a private ledger'. 'Evernorth plans more XRP purchases' reposts describe an Oct 23 preliminary filing that does not confirm buying. Also still unconfirmed from earlier: no Bank of America–Ripple partnership, no Trump family quote about XRP, and no rule stopping retail from buying XRP. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins messages fit common scam patterns. Tonight's 'Garlinghouse spotted leaving Nasdaq, something monumental' posts have no source, and 'Germany's largest stock exchange says XRP will hit $100' has no matching statement. The trust bank approval is real, but it is a charter for custody and RLUSD reserves, not a bank that takes deposits. Details are in the rumors section.

news.headline: Ripple Receives Final OCC Approval to Establish National Trust Bank
news.summary: The OCC granted final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank, after conditional approval in December 2025. It will manage segregated RLUSD reserves, act as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders and offer fiduciary digital asset custody. RLUSD issuance stays with Standard Custody & Trust (NYDFS-regulated).

news.headline: Ripple National Trust Bank receives final OCC approval for crypto custody
news.summary: Explains the approval: a fiduciary-only national trust bank (proposed charter 25364) that will not take deposits or make loans. Circle, Paxos and BitGo got conditional approvals in the same December batch.

news.headline: Ripple Treasury Introduces Always-On Corporate Treasury Platform to Modernize Corporate Cash Management
news.summary: Unveiled at Swell: AI-assisted workflow orchestration for treasury teams and '24/7 Returns' on qualifying digital assets such as RLUSD held in a Ripple wallet, for eligible corporate customers.

news.headline: US spot XRP ETFs see $4.25 million in weekly inflows after brief outflow
news.summary: Weekly net inflows of about $4.25M reversed the prior week's $1.84M outflow, while bitcoin, ether and Solana ETFs saw outflows. Relays SoSoValue data.

news.headline: XRP sits 64% below its peak as BlackRock rumors run wild before Swell
news.summary: XRP near $1.28 earlier Monday, about 64% below its $3.65 high; notes no BlackRock XRP deal or filing is confirmed, and reports about $81.8M of net XRP outflows from Upbit, Binance and Coinbase.

news.headline: Aviva Investors steps up digital assets push by tokenising largest fund
news.summary: Aviva Investors rolled out a tokenized share class of its £22 billion Sterling Liquidity Fund on the XRP Ledger, after its dollar-fund class in July, and plans to extend tokenization to other funds. The two tokenized classes hold a little over £86 million; Komainu and Licuido are the custody and tokenization partners.

news.headline: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
news.summary: Bitcoin fell nearly 2% to about $79,800 in Asian hours Monday; ether and XRP led losses among majors, with XRP down about 3% to $1.28. Traders are watching Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Wednesday press conference for hints of a December hike.

news.headline: Bitcoin pinned at $80.2k as oil, rate jitters dent crypto appetite
news.summary: Bitcoin moved little early Monday after weekend losses, near the bottom of its one-month $80,000 to $87,000 range. Oil eased from six-month highs on reports of more Iran talks; the Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan all meet this week and are expected to hold. XRP was down about 0.5%.

news.headline: XRP takes over New York City subway advertising
news.summary: XRP-branded ads with US flags and the slogan 'Crypto Responsibly' appeared on subway cars and in stations around 42nd Street ahead of Ripple's Swell conference. Cost, length and scope of the campaign are not officially confirmed.

news.headline: Mastercard praises Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin
news.summary: Relays a community member's report from the XRPL Commons hackathon floor that Mastercard representatives complimented RLUSD while explaining partner pitch requirements. Mastercard is an official hackathon partner; nothing new was announced.

news.headline: Ripple and Arf target the short funding gap behind cross-border payments
news.summary: Explainer on the Oct 22 Arf deal: loans repaid in one to five days; Arf's $10B figure is its existing annual settlement activity, not a new loan pool or XRP purchase commitment.

news.headline: XRP Ledger bug fix moved to November after validator support dipped for two hours
news.summary: Support for fixCleanup3_4_0 briefly fell to 26 of 35 validators, resetting its 14-day clock; activation moves from Oct 23 to about Nov 4, and support is now 31 of 35.

news.headline: Arf and Ripple partner to bring settlement liquidity to the XRP Ledger
news.summary: Swiss-regulated Arf (about $10B a year in settlement volume) will lend RLUSD on XRPL to licensed payment firms for 1 to 5 days. A later phase depends on validators approving the XLS-65/66 lending amendments. No RLUSD amount was disclosed.

news.headline: Hold RLUSD in any Binance account to share 600,000 XRP rewards
news.summary: Binance campaign running Oct 23 to Nov 20 (UTC): eligible users holding at least 0.01 RLUSD share a 600,000 XRP pool paid weekly on Fridays starting Oct 30. KYC and supported regions only; the US is among excluded jurisdictions. A promotion, not a change to XRP itself.

news.headline: Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand central banks expand cross-border stablecoin initiative involving Ripple, Visa and Mastercard
news.summary: MAS confirmed Bank Negara Malaysia and the Bank of Thailand joined its BLOOM initiative as policymaker members. Ripple is one of many participants (with Visa, Mastercard, Circle, Coinbase, JPMorgan); its role, announced in March, is a trial of RLUSD trade payments on the XRP Ledger.

news.headline: Evernorth files preliminary S-1 for up to 5.2M shares under a Cantor equity facility
news.summary: The Ripple-backed XRP treasury company (Nasdaq: XRPN) registered up to 5,218,935 shares it may sell to Cantor, about $80.7M at the cover price. The filing is not yet effective and does not itself confirm new XRP purchases. A separate Oct 19 prospectus covers 11.5M shares issuable from warrants.

news.headline: XRP News: Ripple joined DTCC's tokenization push this week. Can it pull XRP out of its October slide?
news.summary: Notes Ripple Prime has been in DTCC's tokenization working group since May 4 (not new), that DTCC's first production trades ran on Besu and Canton without the XRP Ledger, and that no DTCC commitment to use XRP exists. XRP was about $1.31, down about 12% in October.

news.headline: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million of money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
news.summary: Two $75M subscriptions brought Franklin's tokenized money-market fund (sgBENJI) on XRPL to about 193M shares, roughly $200M, all held in one wallet that shares signers with Franklin's issuing account. Who the investors are is undisclosed. These are fund shares, not XRP purchases.

news.headline: U.S. spot XRP ETFs record no net flows on Oct 23, ending a two-day inflow run
news.summary: Flat flows on Oct 23 after inflows on Oct 21 and 22. Cumulative net inflows about $1.81B; net assets about $1.48B; daily trading volume $18.8M.

news.headline: Ripple prepares 80+ sessions at Swell 2026 as banks and developers gather for three days in New York
news.summary: Swell runs Oct 27–29 at The Shed in Manhattan with 100+ speakers including executives from CME, BNY, Robinhood and ICE, and is combined with XRPL Apex and UBRI Connect this year. Agenda preview only; no announcements are confirmed in advance.

news.headline: Crypto under weekend pressure: bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
news.summary: The WSJ reported the US is evacuating personnel across the Middle East on threat of Iranian attacks; bitcoin fell to its weakest level in more than a month and XRP, ether and solana were down 3% to 4% at the time.

news.headline: Bitcoin price today: BTC recovers to $80,800 ahead of Fed meeting
news.summary: Bitcoin bounced from a Saturday low of about $79,146; more than $810M of crypto positions were liquidated in 24 hours (Coinglass). Traders are watching the Fed's Oct 27–28 meeting and Brent oil above $117.

news.headline: Trump says Iran strikes could come today. Can bitcoin hold $80,000?
news.summary: President Trump said the US could strike Iran as soon as Sunday or reach a deal instead; the piece reviews how bitcoin moved on earlier Iran headlines this month. Context for weekend volatility, not XRP-specific.

news.headline: XRP ETFs took in just $4.3 million in a week. Could WisdomTree's fund change that?
news.summary: Using SoSoValue data, spot XRP ETFs took in $4.3M from Oct 19 to 22 and nothing on Oct 23. Cumulative inflows are $1.80B but assets are $1.48B, mainly because XRP's price has fallen.

news.headline: Ripple schedules up to 1 billion XRP escrow release for Nov. 1, 2026
news.summary: Routine monthly escrow unlock at 00:00 UTC Nov 1. In October, 700M of the 1B released was re-locked. How much stays out or is sold is not known in advance.

claims.claim: BREAKING: Ripple gets final OCC approval to run a U.S. national trust bank
claims.who: Brad Garlinghouse and many community reposts on X, Oct 26
claims.check: True: Ripple's Business Wire press release says the OCC granted final approval. Some reposts overstate it: it is a fiduciary trust bank for RLUSD reserves and custody, with no deposits or lending, and it is not an XRP purchase or price event.
claims.check_title: Ripple via Business Wire: Ripple Receives Final OCC Approval to Establish National Trust Bank

claims.claim: Garlinghouse and Alderoty spotted coming out of Nasdaq in New York: 'Something monumental is happening!'
claims.check: No source or mainstream report. Ripple executives are in New York for Swell (Oct 27 to 29), so being seen in Manhattan is expected and implies no Nasdaq deal.

claims.claim: Germany's largest stock exchange says XRP will be the backbone of the new financial system and could hit $7 to $9, even $100
claims.check: No named speaker, no link to any Deutsche Börse statement, and no mainstream report found. Price targets like this are opinion at best.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Aviva Investors launches a tokenized share class of its £22B sterling fund on the XRP Ledger
claims.check: True, and corroborated by mainstream financial press (Financial News). But the £22B is the whole fund; about £86M is in the tokenized classes, and these are fund shares, not XRP purchases.
claims.check_title: Financial News: Aviva Investors steps up digital assets push by tokenising largest fund

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP takes over New York City trains
claims.who: RippleXity and reposts on X, Oct 26
claims.check: The subway ads are real per videos and crypto-press reporting, timed to Swell. It is a marketing campaign; it does not signal a partnership, adoption or price move. No mainstream coverage; cost and sponsor details unconfirmed.
claims.check_title: U.Today: XRP takes over New York City subway advertising

claims.claim: BREAKING: Ripple CEO says XRP market cap will be $196 trillion in days, pricing XRP at $118,920, 'confirmed during the meeting with Trump in Las Vegas'
claims.who: Paula Talks Crypto on X, Oct 26
claims.check: No such statement or meeting is reported anywhere. A $196 trillion market cap would exceed global stock-market value. No mainstream or crypto-press corroboration.

claims.claim: $27,000,000,000,000 BlackRock to sell Ripple XRP!!!
claims.who: Jake's XRP Community on X, Oct 26
claims.check: No source given and no reporting exists; $27 trillion is far larger than XRP's roughly $82B market cap. BlackRock has no XRP product or filing.

claims.claim: XRP priced at $327,000 on a private ledger, confirmed by a researcher; part of a network capacity test
claims.who: Paula Talks Crypto on X, Oct 26
claims.check: No named researcher, ledger or data is given, and no outlet has reported it. Treat as fiction.

claims.claim: FINAL 12-HOUR WARNING: THE RESET IS LIVE ... the old financial rails stop and the new system takes over
claims.who: 'Senator Cynthia lummis RV' account on X (not the senator), Oct 26
claims.check: Countdown-style 'reset' and ISO switch posts from an impersonation-style account fit common scam patterns; nothing is switching off. Do not click links or move coins based on posts like this.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Payments giant Mastercard has reportedly praised Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin during the XRP Ledger Hackathon in New York
claims.who: Community reposts on X (originating with XRPL community member Lost Art, Oct 24)
claims.check: The praise was reported from the event floor and Mastercard is a listed hackathon partner, but it was a compliment, not a deal: no Mastercard product, XRPL integration or XRP support was announced. Crypto press corroboration only, no mainstream coverage.
claims.check_title: U.Today: Mastercard praises Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin

claims.claim: RIPPLE XRP GLOBAL TAKEOVER CONFIRMED! XRP Powers BIS Unified Ledger & Cross-Border Payments
claims.check: The only BIS link is Working Paper 1374, a prototype that stamps fingerprints of statistics on the XRP Ledger; the authors call it blockchain-agnostic, the BIS says research is not an endorsement, and Ripple says it has no current BIS partnership. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: Bitcoin.com News: Ripple no longer with BIS task force

claims.claim: Why is Ripple planning to release 1.3 billion XRP on November 1st instead of 1 billion? ... a BlackRock ETF or some type of announcement?
claims.check: The scheduled Nov 1 escrow release is up to 1 billion XRP, the same as every month; about $1.3 billion is its dollar value at today's price, not a bigger unlock. Nothing links it to BlackRock. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: Ripple schedules up to 1 billion XRP escrow release for Nov. 1

claims.claim: BlackRock's Max Stein highlights a blockchain-agnostic future as XRP ETF rumors surface; holders watch his Swell appearance for signals
claims.check: Stein is listed on a Swell panel and has said BlackRock is 'agnostic to the blockchain', but he did not name XRP, and BlackRock has not filed for or announced an XRP ETF. 'Watch for signals' is speculation. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: CoinTurk: BlackRock's Max Stein highlights blockchain-agnostic future

claims.claim: XRP supercycle incoming? $45.50 price target viral as Ripple secures massive $10B payments partner
claims.who: @barronturmp8 (name mimics Barron Trump), copied by other accounts
claims.check: Misreads the Arf partnership: $10B is Arf's own annual settlement volume, not a deal size or committed XRP Ledger volume, and the deal uses RLUSD, not XRP. The price target has no source. Lookalike account name. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: Arf: Arf and Ripple partner to bring settlement liquidity to the XRP Ledger

claims.claim: JUST IN: Evernorth named Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as execution partners to begin deploying its 473 million XRP treasury
claims.check: Real, but old: Evernorth announced this on Oct 14, subject to closing conditions and approvals, with no amounts disclosed. Reposting it as 'just in' makes it look new.

claims.claim: BREAKING: BlackRock just signed a massive $6.5 TRILLION XRP tokenization deal
claims.who: @DonaldTrumlf (display name 'Commentary Donald Trump jr.', an unverified lookalike account; about 14 views)
claims.check: No source given, and no BlackRock or Ripple announcement or mainstream report of any such deal exists; the figure is larger than BlackRock's entire assets under management. The account impersonates a public figure's name. No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: Franklin Templeton just added $192 million worth of $XRP
claims.check: Misreads a real story. CoinDesk reports Franklin Templeton put about $150M of its tokenized money-market fund shares (sgBENJI) on the XRP Ledger, for about $200M total; those are fund shares issued on the ledger, not purchases of XRP.
claims.check_title: CoinDesk: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million of money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger

claims.claim: The Ripple × Xaman Anniversary XRP Airdrop is now LIVE
claims.who: @XRPL_Fndt (display name 'XAM | WALLET'; about 9.6K views), promoted in replies to Xaman's official account
claims.check: Likely impersonation scam. The account is not Xaman's official @XamanWallet, and Xaman's help center says it does not run airdrops or giveaways. On Oct 23 an X user (@libertine1042) posted that all 1,633 of their XRP left their wallet after opening a 'Xaman airdrop', and so-called 'recovery' accounts then replied offering help, a common follow-up scam. Never connect a wallet, sign a transaction, or enter secret numbers on a 'claim' page, and ignore unsolicited recovery offers. Links deliberately not opened. No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: BlackRock XRP ETF announcement at Ripple Swell next week?
claims.check: Posed as a question with no source. BlackRock has never filed for a spot XRP ETF, per The Motley Fool (Oct 6) and other reviews of SEC filings; Swell's published agenda has a session on the first year of spot XRP ETFs but names no BlackRock filing. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: The Motley Fool: BlackRock has no plans to launch an XRP ETF

claims.claim: Evernorth is about to buy more XRP with a filing for 11.5M new XRPN shares
claims.check: The filings are real: an Oct 19 prospectus for 11.5M shares issuable if public warrants are exercised at $11.50, and a new Oct 23 S-1 for up to 5.2M shares via Cantor. Evernorth says it intends to raise money to grow its XRP treasury, but neither filing confirms a purchase, and the warrant shares are not new stock sold by the company today.

claims.claim: BREAKING: Ripple and Bank of America partnership officially confirmed
claims.check: No such announcement on Ripple's press page or in any mainstream or crypto outlet. The documented link is older and narrower: Bank of America is a long-listed RippleNet member, connects through Ripple Treasury's bank gateway, and disclosed a small XRP ETF holding in a Feb 2026 SEC filing. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: BSC News: what XRP's relationship with banks actually looks like
